headline: Singapore Cryptocurrency Volume Reaches $284 Billion Driven by Institutions
summary: Chainalysis data shows cryptocurrency transaction value in Singapore reached $284 billion, supported by a 94% surge in institutional trading activity, while regional peers saw elevated P2P usage.
why: Singapore has positioned itself as a premier regulated hub for digital asset management and institutional financial technology in Asia.

impacts.name: Singapore
impacts.why: Institutional adoption reinforces Singapore's position as a regional hub for digital asset liquidity.
